parsed.rationale_overall: Both lists cover similar ground (tech concentration, crypto reduction, tax optimization) with comparable personalization and risk framing, but System A contains a questionable factual claim that the user needs ~18-20% annual returns to reach FIRE (the math actually works at ~8-9% given high contributions, which A itself acknowledges elsewhere—an internal inconsistency). System B's actionable steps are more concrete and comprehensive (specific dollar contributions across 401k/Roth/HSA, glide-path bond strategy, specific wash-sale substitutes), giving it a slight edge in actionability and grounding.
